name: dz-calc
description: DZ-Sheets / جداول الجزائر — The Algerian Open-Source Spreadsheet & Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets Alternative. 100% offline-first, high-performance calculation grid, native Algerian fiscal functions (=TAFQIT_AR, =TVA_DZ, =TIMBRE_DZ), built-in payroll (Fiche de Paie) & accounting templates (TCR, SCF). Built to the HeyPuter/everything standard.
author: DZ Open Suite Contributors
